title: Tag Propagation Settings
description: Controls whether tags applied to a service, database or schema flow down to the assets beneath them. Off by default: turning it on changes which tags every affected asset reports, and therefore what existing tag-based policies match. Run a search reindex after changing this setting — see `enabled`.

enabled.description: Propagate tags from a parent down to its assets. Propagated labels are reported as `Derived`, so they are read-only on the asset and disappear when the parent's tag is removed. Changing this setting takes effect immediately on the API but not in search: a search document only picks up (or sheds) an inherited tag when its parent is next written, so until a reindex runs, Explore and any tag-based search filtering keep showing the previous state for assets whose parent has not changed since the toggle. Reindex after enabling or disabling.
